ValidationRule.description: Origin must carry one of the three CaseOrigin values M1-S01 defines; routing and the acknowledgement read it. Bypass: Bypass_Case_Intake_Validation (M2-S01). Rationale: deploy-order.md.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Set Origin to Email-Support, Email-Billing or Web before saving this case. Assignment and the customer acknowledgement both read Origin, so a case with a blank or unrecognised Origin is neither routed nor acknowledged.
